basic_profile.bio: I'm a culinary enthusiast hailing from Phoenix, Arizona, currently working as a freelance graphic designer. My interests revolve around experimenting with plant-based recipes and exploring new food narratives, especially within the realm of food-themed games. I'm in a long-term relationship and we love to cook together during our free time. My online hours vary, but I'm usually active in the evenings post-work. I dislike overly commercialized food trends and prefer authentic, home-cooked meals.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and a passion for culinary arts, primarily self-taught through online courses and cooking shows. My interest in food-themed games has enriched my understanding of culinary storytelling, which I often discuss in niche Reddit communities.
